scope: Remote accessibility evidence for official REDIAM trail geometries

github_actions_attempts.strategy: WFS GML request filtered by confirmed CODIGOEQUI
Official KML URL shape with browser-like headers and per-route Junta referer

conclusion: The source registry is complete, but REDIAM rejects direct geometry downloads from the GitHub Actions runner in both tested request strategies. This is recorded as an external access blocker; it is not treated as missing source data and no track is marked geometry-validated.
next_safe_options: Run the reproducible auditor from an environment allowed by REDIAM and preserve the generated evidence.
Use an official downloadable mirror if one is published by Junta de Andalucia.
Do not proxy, scrape around access controls, infer geometry, or mark tracks validated without parsed evidence.
